entities.name: Query DOCK-family protein
observations: 768 aa sequence; predicted molecular mass 87.0 kDa and theoretical pI 6.50.
Pfam detects DOCK_N at residues 83–435, DOCK-C2 at 440–631, and TPR_DOCK at 644–741.

Sequence searches found approximately 40% identity across 95.6% of the query to DOCK-family reference proteins, but reference coverage was only about 39%, consistent with a conserved fragment or compact homolog.
No curated catalytic reaction, cofactor, localization, or GO annotation was directly transferred by the protein tool.

entities.name: DOCK-family GEF
observations: DOCK-family proteins are multidomain regulators of Rho-family small GTPases; this interpretation is based on the query's highly significant DOCK-specific domain architecture and homologous sequence matches, not on a direct curated annotation for the query.
